environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4). Traffic passes directly to the Flask application on port 8080. No WAF or request inspection is configured. The application is accessed via internal VPC DNS at http://internal-api.corp.local:8080. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. Authentication is handled by a shared API key passed in X-Api-Key header, validated by a lightweight nginx sidecar that only checks key presence (non-empty), not content inspection.

config.network: VPC internal, SG allows 10.0.0.0/8 on TCP/8080
config.auth: nginx sidecar validates X-Api-Key header is non-empty
